data.name: Cold tire pressure (2WD)
data.notes: Normal driving, front and rear. Above 100 mph (160 km/h), where legal, add 5 psi (30 kPa) front and rear; never exceed the tire sidewall maximum. Applies to 205/65R16 95H, 215/55R17 94V, 235/45R18 94V and 235/40R19 92V (types A–E). 235/40R19 96Y (type F): 33 psi (230 kPa), p. 586.

data.name: Cold tire pressure (AWD)
data.notes: Normal driving, front and rear. Above 100 mph (160 km/h), where legal, add 5 psi (30 kPa) front and rear; never exceed the tire sidewall maximum. Applies to 215/55R17 94V, 235/45R18 94V, and 235/40R19 92V on 19 × 8 J wheels (types A–C). 235/40R19 92V on 19 × 8 1/2 J wheels (type D): 35 psi (240 kPa), p. 588.

data.name: Cold tire pressure
data.notes: Normal driving, front and rear. Above 100 mph (160 km/h), where legal, add 5 psi (30 kPa) front and rear; never exceed the tire sidewall maximum. Same for every listed tire (205/65R16, 215/55R17, 235/45R18, 235/40R19; types A–E, pp. 551–553).
